funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; must have a confirmed publisher and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for individuals to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; up to £20,000 for postdoctoral level or above.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for research travel and/or research time to address specific research questions in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for students to begin or continue their studies at master’s or doctoral level.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country; research on eighteenth‑ and nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and related costs for students to examine historical works on paper firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 for one year (or split over two years for part‑time)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a master’s degree place at a UK institution, starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master’s degree that brings new perspectives to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a doctorate at a UK institution, starting between April 2027 and April 2028; open to international applicants (fees fixed).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research, covering tuition and living expenses, to expand understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at postdoctoral level or with equivalent experience.
opportunities.summary: Funding to undertake an in‑depth research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board, accommodation and honorarium for a three‑month stay

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre‑doctoral to senior level.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome for advanced research on British‑Italian cultural exchange.
